text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, 
do you have some time after this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I recently found a cafe I really like. 
I was hoping you might join me—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, here comes the train!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Bound for Shinjuku! 
Great, this'll get us there in time! 
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait... please hold on!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um... just as I thought. 
Rather than this train, the limited 
express arriving after it 
will get you there faster.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really...? 
Even though it's coming later?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it feels strange, but... 
If you're in a hurry, it's best to let 
this one pass.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-You saved us...! 
Thanks to you, we got our errands done!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You sure know yer way around the city 
trains...! 
An' on top of that, ya even found a 
favorite cafe 
in the big city, didn't ya?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A real "city girl"...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. 
I'm still learning myself—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. 
Would it be alright if we invited the two 
of them along? 
There are so many things I'd like to talk 
about.
choice_data_list:
Sure, if they'd like to, let's all go 
together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week & Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay, we'd love to~~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Go out through this ticket gate and head 
straight— 
down this street.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa... 
It sure is crowded again today~! 
Gotta make sure we don't get separated!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's always like this here. 
...Always, every day.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
When I first moved to the city, the crowds 
surprised me so much. 
I was swallowed up by the sea of people in 
no time 
and completely lost where I was heading...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aah~, I know that feeling! 
You get swept along by the rush, pop out 
of the line, 
and suddenly you're on a completely 
unfamiliar street...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And besides that... being surrounded by 
buildings 
and unable to see into the distance felt 
so strange.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Without the mountains or the sea in sight, 
it was so hard to get my bearings at 
first...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that the truth! 
Ya can't just say, "As long as I head 
towards that mountain, I'll get there."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All the tall buildings look the same, 
and there are so many alleys...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a concrete jungle...! 
I really came to understand what that 
phrase meant.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I still run into trouble now and then. 
For example—when the town layout suddenly 
changes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............Yes. 
Just like right now—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Our shop has relocated to the 3rd floor 
of the Grass Building."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's alright. 
Checking the building name on the map 
app... this way.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Closed for construction." 
...We were able to walk through here just 
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Why now of all times~...! 
Is the city like, *always* under 
construction!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but there's a detour map. 
If we take a detour and cut through here—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I see. 
It's a route cutting through the building.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Which escalator 
are we supposed to take~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, from where we are now, 
we take the connecting walkway and exit 
towards the station...
choice_data_list:
Let's ask an information attendant just to 
be safe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And so, after stumbling and struggling 
to find our way...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...The city isn't the kind of place where 
learning the way just once is enough, is 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly it! 
Everything changes way too fast!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trends, buildings, the speed people walk 
at... 
Ah, but! Having the next train come so 
quickly 
is really nice!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Hehe, it really is!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if we're managing alright. 
The two of us.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We sure are. 
It's tough, but let's keep doin' our best 
together!
choice_data_list:
If there's ever anything I can do to help, 
just say the word!

You're all doing so well in an unfamiliar 
place...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In that case... 
would you be willing to join our LANE 
group?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
There's a group called the "City Mutual 
Aid Society" 
for girls who moved here from the 
countryside...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes please! 
Having a "city boy" with us 
would be a huge help!
choice_data_list: I'll help with whatever I know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes please! 
Having a "city girl" with us 
would be a huge help!
choice_data_list: I'll help with whatever I know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I was inaugurated 
as the caretaker of the mutual aid 
society!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. It's true that this is unfamiliar 
ground... 
Yet here we are, gathered at the same 
academy from similar walks of life, 
striving forward each and every day.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Just having that brings so much 
reassurance.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! 
Me too!

title: A Tale of Coming from the Snow Country
